document.editionNote: The Conclusion on PDF page 33 is signed 'District Collector, Krishnagiri District' with a hand-written date of 22/11/19, and the PDF's CreationDate is 22 November 2019. The district website lists it as the notice 'District Environmental protection Plan', start date 29/11/2019, under the 2019/11 upload path (2019112965.pdf). The same site holds the committee-constitution proceedings of 29.8.2019 and minutes of committee meetings held on 06.09.2019, 14.10.2019 and 11.11.2019. No later edition was found on the district, TNPCB or state environment department sites on 2026-09-18.
document.template: Not the CPCB model narrative with district data tables. A cover, an index, a three-page introduction and twelve subject sections (solid waste, bio-medical waste, plastic waste, construction and demolition waste, non-attainment cities, polluted river stretches, polluted industrial clusters, industrial pollution control, utilization of treated sewage, conservation of water bodies, e-waste, sand mining), most of them a preamble of NGT orders followed by a three-column table of responsibility, plan of action and stakeholders, with photograph pages between sections. It prints no demand, supply or deficit water balance.
quirks: PDF page = printed page + 2: the cover and the index are unnumbered, and the introduction starts at printed page 1 on PDF page 3.

PDF page 33 (printed 31: the end of the sand-mining table, the Conclusion and the Collector's signature) is a camera scan whose text layer holds only 'Scanned by CamScanner'; it was read from the page image. It carries no figures.

The four treatment-plant counts on PDF page 24 sit in the middle column of a three-column table. A whole-page text extraction interleaves the neighbouring 'Responsibilities' column into those lines ('required in TNPCB/ Industries.'), so their quotes are the cell text as extracted from that column alone (pdftotext -r 72 -x 248 -y 290 -W 200 -H 215 on page 24).

The plan counts the urban local bodies two ways: the introduction (PDF page 3) says 'one Corporation namely Hosur, one Municipality namely Krishnagiri, 6 Town Panchayats and 10 PanchayatUnions', while the solid-waste section (PDF page 7) says '2 Municipalities, 6 Town Panchayats and 10 Panchayat unions'. Neither is transcribed as a figure.

The section headed 'VI. Rejuvenation of Polluted River Stretches' states that CPCB has identified no polluted stretch in the district and, in the next sentence, that the Cauvery and the Thenpennaiyar enter the district carrying sewage from Bangalore city. Both statements are transcribed as printed.

Place names vary within the document and are kept as printed in each quote: Billikundu, Billigundu and Biligundu; Sokkarasanapalli, Chokkarasanpalli and Chokkarasanapalli; Thenpennaiyar and Thenpennaiar; Arikavathi for the Arkavathi.
The index prints the section title 'Polluted Industrial Cluster' and the section heading prints 'Pollution Industrial Clusters'.

actionPoints.text: The District Collector, Krishnagiri District has instructed the Commissioners Municipalities, Town Panchayats, Panchayas Union and PWD to prepare the DPR for interception and diversion (I & D) of sewage & sullage, carrying drains to the nearby Sewage Treatment Plant (STP).
Identification of cities, towns and villages discharging sewage through drains into river/tributary and their quantification and characterization of pollution load.
Identification of gap between sewage generation and treatment capacities and installing additional STPs and sewerage system where ever needed.
Execution of STP works and necessary infrastructure and ensuring household sewer connection (UGDS) for full utilization of STP.
Inventorisation of water polluting industries near to the river stretch.
Monthly sample collection along the river stretch and analyzing the samples. Displaying of Report of Analysis (ROA) in the official website.
Periodic assessment and remediation of sub-surface flow and ground water quality in the nearby river.
Effective implementation of Rain water harvesting and Ground water recharging.
Identification & Demarcation of encroachments along the river beds.
Quantification of sewage in each of the local bodies.
Number and capacity of STP provided in each of the local bodies.
Treat sewage from the common STPs shall be utilised for Industrial use, Agriculture, ground water recharge and other non domestic use.
Collection of Historical, Geographical and geological data for all the Water Bodies.
Declaring the Designated Best use of water bodies and ascertain the quality of water as per the standard.
Deweeding, Desilting, protection of drainage basin, channels, stabilization of earthen bunds and preparing cost estimation.
Removal of encroachments and blockades, deciding on flood control measures and preparing cost estimation.
